dct_description_sm: Built-in 1912, The Price House is a fantastic example of a Tudor Revival/Edwardian Classical home. This three-storey home showcases the Tudor Revival style on its exterior, defined by its half-timbered and stucco façade, and spotlights the Edwardian Classical style through various ornamentation and arts and crafts components in the interior. The Price House is located in the Glebe community of Ottawa, Ontario, and is part of the Clemow Estate East Heritage District. This is the Integrated Project Dossier compiled by a group of undergraduate students of the Architectural Conservation and Sustainability Program (Engineers and architects) at Carleton University for the CIVE3207 (ARCN4100) Historic Site Recording and Assessment course in 2016.
dct_title_s: The Price House - Integrated Project Dossier (2016)
